name: haxe-dump-opener
description: Open the haxe -D dump output for the type under the cursor

haxeDump.wrapWidth.description: Dumps open as a read-only view with lines longer than this wrapped, one bracketed element per line. Refreshes when a rebuild rewrites the dump. 0 opens the raw file.

haxeDump.wrapDepth.description: How many bracket levels deep a long line gets broken. 1 = only the outermost group (e.g. one array entry per line, each entry kept whole). 0 = no limit.

haxeDump.wrapSkipMeta.description: Metadata whose arguments are left on one line, e.g. ":value" (the initializer copy the compiler adds next to every field).

haxeDump.metaBraces.description: Completing the name of metadata that takes one structure (a single "{…}" in its haxe-metadata.json params) inserts "({})" and opens the suggestions inside the braces.

haxeDump.metaBracesOnParen.description: Typing "(" after the name of metadata that takes one structure suggests "{…}", which inserts the braces and opens the suggestions inside them.

commands.title: Haxe: Open .dump for Class to the Side
